title: AlphaTensor Matrix Multiplication Suite over F₂ (6 Benchmark Shapes)
description: Six formally verified world-record tensor-rank hill-climb challenges over F₂ spanning ⟨3,3,3⟩ (rank 23, open since Laderman 1976), ⟨3,3,4⟩ (29), ⟨3,4,4⟩ (38), ⟨3,4,5⟩ (47), ⟨3,5,5⟩ (58), and ⟨4,4,5⟩ (63, AlphaTensor Nature 2022 — strictly improvable!). Reuses the verbatim Apache-2.0 `B334.RankLE (B334.mmT n m p) r` specification from `tejasvi/rank444-f2` with verified baselines from DeepMind's Apache-2.0 `google-deepmind/alphatensor`.

tasks.title: Reduce ⟨3,3,3⟩ rank over F₂ below 23
tasks.description: Improve the verified F₂ bilinear rank bound for ⟨3,3,3⟩ over F₂ (baseline 23, open since Laderman 1976). Submit your coefficient bitmask triples in `RankF2/Cert333.lean` (`B334.score333` and `B334.cert333`). Frozen `RankF2/Bound333.lean` checks all 729 Brent equations inside the Lean 4 kernel (`decide +kernel`).
